ulcer-index.title: Ulcer Index (14) on the S&P 500 ETF
ulcer-index.caption: The root mean square of the percentage drawdown of the close from its 14-bar high, averaged over 14 bars. It stays at zero while price holds near its highs and rises as pullbacks get deeper or last longer. Rises are ignored.

vertical-horizontal-filter.title: Vertical Horizontal Filter (28) on Apple
vertical-horizontal-filter.caption: The VHF divides the 28-bar range of closes by the sum of all the bar to bar moves. Higher readings mean price has travelled in one direction, and lower readings mean it has zig-zagged. It gives no direction.
